shortDescription: El Salvador’s government holds 7,808.37 BTC after adding 8 BTC over the past seven days and 31 BTC over the past 30 days, with its holdings valued at $638 million. According to ChainCatcher, the government’s Bitcoin reserve has now surpassed 7,800 BTC.
